descriptions.counterfactual: A steel sphere hangs beside a fixed red-and-blue permanent bar magnet with visible pole markings. A fixed vertical gauge shows the sphere is pulled sideways toward the magnet. An ordinary copper sheet slides along an overhead rail into the gap without touching the sphere or magnet. After the sheet stops, it wrongly blocks the steady magnetic attraction and the sphere returns toward the vertical gauge line.
descriptions.true: A steel sphere hangs beside a fixed red-and-blue permanent bar magnet with visible pole markings. A fixed vertical gauge shows the sphere is pulled sideways toward the magnet. An ordinary copper sheet slides along an overhead rail into the gap without touching the sphere or magnet. After the sheet stops, the sphere remains deflected toward the magnet.
